name: CAPA No-CNI (BYO-CNI) Cluster Provisioning
description: Provision a ROSA HCP cluster using CAPA with networkType: Other (default OVNKubernetes CNI disabled, bring-your-own CNI) on MCE 5.0 RC (OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel), with automated network and role configuration

playbooks.name: Create CAPA No-CNI Cluster
playbooks.description: Provisions a ROSA HCP cluster using CAPA with networkType set to Other (BYO-CNI), plus ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig automation

documentation.overview: This test suite provisions a ROSA HCP cluster using CAPA with the CNI plugin disabled. The RosaControlPlane is rendered from the rosa-no-cni-cluster feature template, which sets networkType: Other so the default OVNKubernetes CNI is not installed and the user brings their own CNI (BYO-CNI). Validated against MCE 5.0 RC on OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6 (candidate channel).
prerequisites: MCE/ACM hub cluster (5.0 RC) with CAPI/CAPA configured
A plan/manifests to install a third-party CNI after provisioning (nodes will be NotReady until a CNI is installed)
expected_results: ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig resources created (network + IAM automation)
RosaControlPlane applied from the rosa-no-cni-cluster template with networkType: Other
Cluster provisions with networkType Other (default OVNKubernetes CNI disabled)
User is responsible for installing a CNI; nodes remain NotReady until a CNI is applied
Playbook waits for RosaControlPlane status.ready to become true
